field_notes.list_price / original_list_price: USD. original_list_price = first ask of the current marketing run, including relists that the price history shows were part of the same run. Earlier separate runs are in price_history and prior_runs_note.
field_notes.days_on_market: The DOM number the source page states for the current listing (source named in dom_source). Relists reset this on Redfin, so see dom_cumulative_est where history shows a longer run.
field_notes.dom_cumulative_est: Days from original_list_price date to 2026-10-14, computed from price history. Includes off-market gaps where noted. This is a computation, not a source figure.
field_notes.dead_contracts: Number of pending/contingent -> back-on-market or -> removed-then-relisted events inside the current run. dead_contracts_prior_runs counts the same events in earlier runs.
field_notes.seller_financing: yes only if listing text says so; otherwise no (remarks read, no mention) or unknown.
field_notes.agent_email_shown: The email the Redfin page displayed in the listing-agent block. Several are clearly office/team/broker inboxes, not the named agent. Treat as unverified.

method_notes: Collected 2026-10-14 with Firecrawl scrape (live fetch, maxAge 0). DISCOVERY: Redfin land filter pages for 22101, 22102, 22180, 22181, 22182, 22066, 22041, 22043, 22046, 22124, 20816, 20817 and Arlington city. Redfin house filters (old houses on larger lots) for McLean, Vienna, Arlington and 20817 to find teardowns. Zillow /land/ pages for McLean (pages 1-2), Vienna, Arlington, Falls Church, Great Falls, Oakton, Bethesda. One web search for teardown keywords; it turned up 1646 La Salle Ave McLean, which is PENDING and was excluded. DETAIL: every Redfin listing was pulled from its own property page through LLM JSON extraction (price history, agent block, MLS#). 1114 N Stuart St and 3970 26th St N come from Zillow detail pages only. ACTIVE STATUS: every listing showed 'For sale/active' on its detail page fetched 2026-10-14. 8606 Jefferson St is an online auction. EXCLUDED per instructions: all addresses on the already-analyzed list (Linway Ter, Knolewood lots, Madrillon, Campbell, 9113 Jeffery, 264 Golden Woods, 10848 Patowmack, Blake Ln, Anchorage, 4318 9th St S, 28th St S, 7314 Idylwood, 3203 W Ox, 1865 Old Reston, 6411 83rd Pl, etc.). Also left out: 950/956 Langley Forest Ct (ordinary new lots, kept the list within 24); the Acanti Estates undisclosed lots (builder lot+home packages); 6228 Clearwood (builder package; used as a sold comp); 5730 Columbia Pike (commercial); out-of-market Herndon/Sterling/Potomac/Fairfax 22031/DC finds; 1551 Evers Dr McLean (land, $1.65M, $40K cut 9/27, Compass), dropped because its Zillow page had no agent or price history; 9187 Old Dominion, 717 Kentland, 518 Goldsmith Ln, 10808 Georgetown Pike, 10708 Meadowood Dr, 8419 Wesleyan St, 2530 Leeds Rd, 6220 Hardy Dr and the N Stuart St sibling parcels, which were seen on Zillow but not pulled in detail (candidates for a follow-up sweep). CAVEATS: (1) LLM extraction made at least two known errors, which were corrected by re-reading: 0 Pollard falsely flagged as seller financing (the text is construction-to-perm lender financing), and the sold-card dates on Redfin's Arlington JSON pass (repeated 'Dec 12, 2025'). Sold comps marked 'json card extraction - verify' have not been checked against the page text. (2) Redfin price histories sometimes contain duplicate or out-of-order rows (650 Walker Rd, 9203 Potomac Ridge Rd, 9112 Potomac Ridge Rd); these are reproduced with notes. (3) agent_email_shown is whatever the Redfin agent block displayed. Most are office or team inboxes, not the named agent. Phones marked '(broker line)' are brokerage numbers. No owner contact info was looked up. (4) Redfin DOM resets on relist, so dom_cumulative_est is computed from history and is not a source figure. (5) No listing text offered seller financing. (6) Zillow 'days on Zillow' was often blank on search cards. Where both sources had DOM it agreed within 1 day. (7) Year built/sqft for 3013 Graham Rd is garbage on Redfin (1700 / 95 sf) and is recorded as unknown. No commit was made.
